Happy Birthday to the most gorgeous and professionally ethical person in the entire world.

To take us down memory lane: here are some problems I was facing in 2024
1 Katherine can’t stop singing When I was 13…
2 Katherine can’t focus her eyes on ME!! ONLY!!!
3 Katherine doesn’t FaceTime me anymore…

And now in the current space and time, I will have to admit those three problems still hold truth. They need resolving because we have this relationship that is more squirmy than little m’s hand shake in Santa Tell Me.

Your favorite milla is so proud of you learning how to wipe ur ass alone, how to eject snot, and how to lick ur milk mustache clean. All work I was supposed to do, but now atlas have retired. Essential life skills I hope you will remember for the rest of your life.

For seventeen, I wish you room to grow in every single direction. Make beautiful things. Make disgusting jokes. Be proud of yourself. Clap your hands often (cuz If you're happy and you know it, clap your hands!) And know that wherever life takes you, there is somebody with great lab lab for u bathe.

historicalText:
This has been a while. The last time I wrote you a letter was on Christmas, and now all the Mi-Mis are outdated. So in order to give you a heart Mi-Mi, I'm here again. 
First off, let me clear something up (in other words, I'm going to be Sirius Black before I become the greatest showman), And I know even without my Gucci and Louis Vuitton, I'd made you look). 
Ok, chop chop, now that's over, ...... Ignore the pause, I'm trying to think of another Mi-Mi and 凑字数. Ok ok ok ok 好的, let's go 情感. I'm always thankful for you, a knucklehead that guesses my lyrics 完形填空 and for me to 训, and to tease me about ac. And to tell you the truth, I only have you, my big fish （插入尔康). <3 Yours,
Carrier Wayne
